name: droidcast-monorepo
description: DroidCast — Real Android-to-Laptop WebRTC Screen Casting System

scripts.signaling: npm run build --workspace=@droidcast/protocol && npm run dev --workspace=@droidcast/signaling
scripts.receiver: npm run build --workspace=@droidcast/protocol && npm run dev --workspace=@droidcast/receiver
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@droidcast/protocol && npx concurrently -n SIGNALING,RECEIVER -c cyan,emerald "npm run dev --workspace=@droidcast/signaling" "npm run dev --workspace=@droidcast/receiver"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=@droidcast/signaling
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@droidcast/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@droidcast/signaling && npm run build --workspace=@droidcast/receiver
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@droidcast/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@droidcast/signaling && npm run typecheck --workspace=@droidcast/receiver
